mechanism_narrative: A further decline in TRANSIT over the next month will mechanically reduce discretionary trip chains to shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining at or below its current level for most of the period.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays above its current level while WORKPLACES remains depressed, households will substitute away from out-of-home shopping and RETAIL_REC will fall within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays below -10 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +4 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days even though WORKPLACES remains below -10 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +4 for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS activity indicates improved leisure mobility and spillover spending, which will lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days even after PARKS rises by at least 3 points from its current weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT drops more than five points week-on-week from an already low base, the implied mobility shock suppresses access to stores and RETAIL_REC turns lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls > 5 points week-on-week from below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the next 7 days after a further TRANSIT drop of more than 5 points from below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in GROCERY_PHARM coupled with weaker PARKS mobility signals a shift toward utilitarian trips and away from leisure outings, which will support RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated and PARKS remains below its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near or below -15, weekday foot traffic loss will dominate any shopping rebound, and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES falls below -15 and stays there for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both rise together, the area is in a warmer-season outing regime that spills into shopping trips, raising RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises while PARKS rises in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase within 14 days after simultaneous weekly gains in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a stabilizing TRANSIT series combined with a continued decline in RESIDENTIAL indicates more time spent outside the home, which should raise RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stabilizes and RESIDENTIAL stops increasing or turns down.
